requirement.title: Keep dress catalog price sorting correct
requirement.description: When a shopper chooses Price: Low to High on the dress catalog, visible cards must be sorted by their displayed rupee price without dropping or duplicating products.
acceptanceCriteria: The initial and sorted product card counts match.
Each displayed price is at least the previous price after selecting Price: Low to High.
The multiset of displayed prices is unchanged by sorting.

requirement.title: Show an empty state for a missing product search
requirement.description: A shopper submits an unlikely search term from the navigation search control. The search results route should explain that no products match.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting a search navigates to the search results route with the query.
A no results message appears for an unmatched term.

requirement.title: Block empty checkout for a signed out shopper
requirement.description: When a guest visits checkout with no cart items, keep payment unavailable and explain both the sign in and empty cart states.
acceptanceCriteria: The shopper sees a sign in prompt and empty cart message.
The simulate payment button is disabled.
